sloka: दर्पान्निराकृता पूर्वं त्वया सौभाग्यवत्तया ।राममाता सपत्नी ते कथं वैरं न शातयेत् ॥२-८-३७॥
transliteration: darpānnirākṛtā pūrvaṁ tvayā saubhāgyavattayā ।rāmamātā sapatnī te kathaṁ vairaṁ na śātayet ॥2-8-37॥

translations.english: Being fortunate (being the favourite wife of your husband) you slighted your cowife earlier with pride. How will she, Rama's mother (Kausalya) remain without retaliating?
